description: This Java source file implements the 'ThingsFieldExpressionFactory' interface, providing methods to create field expressions for filtering, existence checks, and sorting based on property names. It handles field mappings and parsing of feature field strings, primarily used in the context of querying entity fields in a system related to Eid Itto.

classes.name: ThingsFieldExpressionFactoryImpl
classes.description: Final class implementing ThingsFieldExpressionFactory, providing methods for creating filter, existence, and sort expressions based on property names.

methods.name: filterBy
methods.description: Creates a FilterFieldExpression based on a property name, handling feature IDs and properties.

methods.name: existsBy
methods.description: Creates an ExistsFieldExpression for a given property name, identifying feature IDs and properties.

methods.name: sortBy
methods.description: Creates a SortFieldExpression based on a property name, handling feature IDs and properties.

methods.name: stripLeadingSlash
methods.description: Utility method to remove the leading slash from a property name if present.

methods.name: common
methods.description: Internal factory method for generating field expressions for attribute and definition fields, or mapped fields.
